findings.claim: The supplied review material must expose the implementation paths necessary to assess the PageCacheReused event and store contract.
findings.observed: The caller-declared diff visibility is incomplete and explicitly omits audit_events.py, audit_storage.py, and test_monitor_cache_reused_events.py; only unrelated or broader documentation changes are visible, so the implementation semantics cannot be reviewed.
findings.rationale: The visibility contract forbids inferring absence or correctness from omitted paths and requires incomplete evidence/visibility rather than ACCEPT when complete is false.
findings.required: Provide a complete caller-supplied semantic review bundle containing the task-relevant implementation diff, or an equivalent complete artifact, without requiring Acceptance to execute tests.
